note: Scripture follows the Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (OLCB 2017, lug_bib), parsed from the ebible mirror's USX. The English quotes the ASV (1901) and cites it as "(Book C:V, ASV)"; this edition quotes OLCB and drops the ASV tag, and the two statements that all quotations are ASV (Preface, Appendix D) say so for this edition. Every `mined` row's quoted span is a verbatim (case-insensitive) substring of the OLCB verse; ranges keep only the verses the translation verifiably quotes.

`self_rendered` rows are places where OLCB's wording cannot carry the sentence's point (e.g. Col 3:4 'Christ who gives us life' vs 'who is our life'; Phil 1:21 'I live for Christ' vs 'to live is Christ'; Rom 6:14 a command vs a promise; Heb 4:12 'dividing'; Matt 26:38 'soul'), loose or re-personed quotations, and verses OLCB lacks (Matt 26:41b). Where one chapter keeps OLCB and another self-renders the same verse, it is because the second chapter's argument turns on the English sense — each row carries the translator's `why`.
OLCB places 'I have been crucified with Christ' at Gal 2:19; the source's 2:20 citation is kept.
